subject.title: Core hardening tracker: converge duplicated runtime invariants onto single owners

question: Should the two confirmed residuals proceed as separate focused PRs under this umbrella tracker?
rationale: They share the canonical-owner objective but cross distinct session and plugin control-plane boundaries, so combining them would weaken ownership and validation clarity.

options.title: Keep umbrella, split PRs
options.body: Retain this issue, refresh its scope, and implement the session and provider residuals in separate focused PRs.

options.title: Split into dedicated issues
options.body: Create one canonical issue per residual and close this umbrella only after those links preserve the program history.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella, split PRs
recommendation.body: Retain this issue, refresh its scope, and implement the session and provider residuals in separate focused PRs.
